title: Crystal Clear Bar Salts Candy Crush Nic Salts 10ml E-Liquid
description: Crystal Clear Candy Crush Nic Salt delivers a lively flavour inspired by mixed fruit confectionery and fizzy sherbet. Bursting with sweet, fruity notes and a tangy sparkle, this flavour captures the nostalgic essence of classic pick-and-mix with a slightly fizzy edge that dances on the tastebuds. A playful and sweet profile that’s ideal for vapers who enjoy sweeter blends with a light, tangy twist. Blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, this Nic Salt e-liquid works best in MTL (mouth-to-lung) vape kits and pod devices. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths for rapid nicotine relief and a smooth throat hit. Crystal Clear Nic Salts are crafted to deliver the same great-tasting flavours that made disposable vapes so popular, now reimagined for refillable pod kits. Designed for clarity, consistency and convenience, this UK-made range focuses on fruity, icy, and confectionery-inspired blends that cater to everyday vapers.
